name: Omenpaths
description: Omenpaths are rifts or pathways between planes that opened across the planes after the invasion and let travelers move between worlds.

summary.text: Omenpaths are rifts or pathways between planes that opened across the planes after the invasion and let travelers move between worlds.

bio.text: Proft explained that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet said they are natural to Kaldheim.
Niv-Mizzet explained that the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, since they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
Yuma ran off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.

status.text: The latest event shows Yuma using the Omenpaths to flee with the money, and the material records no further events for them.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet explains the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, as they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
timeline.quote: As Living Guildpact, they're my responsibility.

timeline.quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

pages_say.description: Energy pathways between worlds that Elesh Norn generates on the branches of the tree.
Pathways between planes along the branches of the World Tree used to carry the invasion.
Rifts in the fabric of the plane that opened after the invasion, a phenomenon natural to Kaldheim, giving ways on and off Ravnica.
Portals between planes that Yuma used to flee New Capenna.
Portals between planes on Thunder Junction.
Portals between planes through which travelers and reunited families arrive.
Portals that allow non-planeswalkers to travel between planes.
Portals between planes that raise the stakes of the vault's power.
Stable routes between planes that let people without sparks travel.
Portals through which Vraska and Loot travel without a spark.
Tunnels bored through reality by the Invasion, now connecting planes, with a courier service running through them.
